name: 20191 · Reston, VA
findings: ZIP 20191 (Reston) has 291 nonprofit organizations. 129 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 118 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20191 (Reston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20191 (Reston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 118 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
